info.name: WeHire API
info.description: Current implemented WeHire APIs, including one-time setup and administrator management. Setup/Admin writes are skipped unless explicitly enabled; send writes individually after reviewing targets. Import this file; configure private credentials and real numeric application IDs, then run folders in order. Postman cookie jar handles opaque sessions. Logout fetches CSRF automatically without saving tokens into collection variables. Health is public; access endpoints are permission checks, not uploads or recruitment processing. Do not run repeated login loops: account/IP throttling is active. See postman/README.md. Candidate signup is in Registration, skipped unless allow_registration=true. Staff signup is administrator-only.

item.name: Public
item.description: Safe public checks; negative auth requests disable cookies for deterministic results. Invalid login consumes a rate-limit attempt.

exec: pm.test("Private response is not cached", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });
pm.test("Generic login error", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Invalid email or password"); });

item.name: Setup
item.description: GET status is safe. First Admin is gated and only for initial setup with a private key. Never export a populated key/password.

request.description: Writes are skipped unless allow_admin_changes=true. One-time bootstrap only; never reuse after setup.

exec: const payload = {token: pm.variables.get("setup_token"), email: pm.variables.get("admin_email"), password: pm.variables.get("admin_password")};
